description.value:
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can create one magic scroll by touching your Wizardly Quill to a blank piece of paper or parchment and copying one spell from your Awakened Spellbook onto it; the book must be within 5 feet of you. The spell must be of level 1 or 2 and have a casting time of an action. In the scroll, the spell's power is enhanced: it counts as one level higher than normal. You can cast it from the scroll by reading it as a Magic action. The scroll is unintelligible to anyone else, and the spell vanishes from it when you cast it or when you finish your next Long Rest.

You are also adept at crafting Spell Scrolls: the gold and time you must spend to make one are halved if you use your Wizardly Quill.

Foundry Note

Make the scroll from the spell on your sheet (Create Scroll) at one level higher.
